label: MicroPython — ESP32 (classic WROOM/WROVER)
note: Classic ESP32 flashes at 0x1000. Server auto-fetches the latest stable build (falls back to the pinned url).

label: MicroPython — ESP32-S3 Octal PSRAM (N8R8/N16R8)
note: Most S3 devkits (-N8R8/-N16R8) have OCTAL PSRAM. Use this if you saw 'PSRAM … wrong line mode'.

label: MicroPython — ESP32-S3 (no / quad PSRAM)
note: Plain S3. If PSRAM init fails on your board, use the Octal PSRAM build above.

label: Vera Node — MicroPython (main.py)
note: The one MicroPython node firmware — does everything. Pushed over the serial REPL after the runtime is flashed (no compiler). Board-robust pins (override via config.io). A 'worker' is just this same node with recurring edge tasks assigned at runtime via mesh.worker.assign (Worker tasks card) — no separate script. Includes the ESP32 toolkit (RGB/NeoPixel + probe, BLE scan, I2C/touch/temp, channel survey, ESP-NOW ranging, RF positioning, sysinfo, deep-sleep). CSI motion + Wi-Fi promiscuous sniff need the Arduino/IDF build.

label: Vera Node — Arduino sketch (.ino)
note: Compile with arduino-cli (mesh.firmware.build) or the Arduino IDE, then flash the .bin over USB or OTA. Adjust LED/RELAY/ADC #defines per board. Includes a built-in ILI9488 3.5" Uno-shield kiosk driver (8-bit parallel, 320x480) + SD storage — see USE_TFT_ILI9488_P8 / USE_SD_SPI toggles; pins remappable at runtime via config.io.tft / config.io.sd. Full ESP32-S3 toolkit incl. Wi-Fi CSI device-free motion sensing (TOOLKIT_CSI) + promiscuous RF density sniffer (TOOLKIT_SNIFF) + RGB/NeoPixel via rgbLedWrite; each behind a compile flag if a core/board disagrees.
